correctness.rationale: Two parity-neighborhood packings bound each half by 16. Saturation is equivalent to length-seven one-perfect codes. STS(7) uniqueness and coding balls classify exactly 240 such codes. Ordered pairs classify precisely 57600 maximum open packings. Unique nearest codeword yields induced 16-edge matching; affine intersections of linear Hamming cosets give 2^d edges in each of 2^(4-d) used directions; double-counted Fano-line intersections produce (1,7,14,8), yielding all four exact labeled profile counts. Independent exact-cover and Hamming parity-check enumerations and 240 explicit cube-neighborhood tests corroborate each finite step; they are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete extremal-census problem for Q8 is solved: 57600 labeled maximum open-packings distributed among four exact matching-direction patterns, with only 1/30 in any doubled-fiber form. This gives structural data omitted by the earlier cardinality-optimum literature. Fano-plane intersection theory motivates and explains the precise invariant and the non-product phenomenon, rather than obtaining an arbitrary unmotivated small-case numerical table. Limits are clearly restricted to dimension eight and labeled sets.
